integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible exact checks; finite checks do not establish infinite asymptotics. No independent scientific assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet and fixed nondegenerate i.i.d. letter probabilities only.
Ratio of expectations, not expectation of a random ratio or an individual-word concentration statement.
Pointwise asymptotics in probability parameter; deterministic boundary has a different limiting proportion.
No new claim about prior binomial-square identities, the unrestricted distinct-subsequence mean, or contiguous Abelian-square factors.
Equivalent coverage within a broader weighted-language theorem remains a residual originality risk.
title: Square-root suppression of distinct Abelian-square scattered subsequences
